comment: Public leaves that ship with a real implementation even though no roster repo imports them yet. The stub list is consumer-driven, so a primitive published for the fleet to adopt is stubbed on its first release — and a stubbed leaf cannot acquire the consumer that would un-stub it. Each entry names the consumer it waits for. Remove an entry once that consumer lands; the audit reports the entry as redundant.

leaves.reason: EditableYaml. Waits on the fleet migration of regex-based pnpm-workspace.yaml edits to a comment-preserving editor.
The injected-parser types for yaml/edit. Ships with its implementation leaf.
